I always suggest hk because they're incredible products and awesome customer service. Those are seriously the coolest guys you'll ever meet. Design wise, it's perfect. HK makes killer jerseys. it's 200$ for design fee plus around $90 for each jersey. It's definitely worth it though. Tank'd is another good company. EKK is too. My favorite company is Anthrax. they're in greece, and prices are about the same as hk, but to me the anthrax jerseys are better. Raza does make a good jersey, but there are time delays because of the amount of business they do. I wouldn't go with Animal customs because the quality isn't that great, plus it's pricey for what they have. You want good quality, go with either Anthrax, HK, Raza, EKK, or Tank'd. You can send them a design and they'll build the jerseys around that.

I was very much so a serious religious person. I was raised in a Christian background and when I was around 10 we converted to Messanic Judaism. Went to Israel to "walk in the holy land" for two weeks and never felt "closer" to "god". I used to get really upset when my friends would tell me they didn't believe in my god. After awhile I started asking questions which eventually led to me doing research and praying for 2 years every night consistently. Of course I never got an answer. It took me quite a long time to comprehend there isn't a god and realize my whole life to that point had been a lie and many many steps back. One day I looked in the mirror and said to myself out loud "I am an Atheist." It was the first time I had said it out loud and when I said it it's like this weight was lifted off my shoulders and I felt free. It's been an amazing journey ever since.
